sources.revision: G2991-90041 Rev. D / SD-UF0000092 Rev. D, edition 03/2026
sources.scope: Standard Genomic DNA ScreenTape reference preparation and analytical specification ranges; not DIYLabBot qualification
DIN scale and functional concentration range; DIN differs from fragment-size estimates

limitations: Explicit synthetic JSON contract; not a qualified native TapeStation export decoder or device driver
TS01 remains the existing manual planning model; article selection, actual installation and hardware are unqualified
Reference ranges and fixture volumes do not qualify the procedure, DNA integrity, yield, concentration or fragment sizing
Above-range fragment sizes are censored, never represented as precise values; no electropherogram trace is manufactured
Result import and synthetic policy evaluation do not replace explicit operator review, assay completion or workspace handback
No reagent stock, biological material ledger, transport, robot path or network effect is created by the decoder
